jobs.occupation: Software Stability Expert (f/m/x) (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description:
Stellenreferenz: 192515

At BMW Car IT, a wholly owned subsdiary of BMW AG, we live and breathe software. We design and implement embedded aoftware for electronic control units of the BMW cars as well as related tools and frameworks. By delivering software all the way from the idea to the final product we lead BMW into the future of digitalization and mobility.

What awaits you?

- You ensure system stability for Linux and Android-based embedded platforms across software deliveries.
- You analyse and resolve complex issues related to performance, boot behavior, memory management, CPU load, and system services.
- Furthermore, you debug cross-layer issues across kernel, frameworks, HALs, middleware, drivers, and applications.
- In addition, you perform root cause analysis using tracing, profiling, and debugging tools.
- You examine crash dumps, kernel panics, ANRs, watchdog resets, and memory leaks to improve system robustness.
- Moreover, you develop proof of concepts, validation solutions, and automation tools for analysis and monitoring.
- You collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvements in platform reliability and software quality.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a comparable field.
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Linux and Android embedded systems.
- Extensive experience with Linux kernel, Android framework, system services, boot process, and resource management.
- Advanced knowledge of debugging, tracing, profiling, and performance analysis tools such as GDB, Perf, Ft , Perfetto, ADB, and Logcat.
- Experience in analysing crashes, memory leaks, deadlocks,   conditions, kernel panics, ANRs, and performance bottlenecks.
- Professional experience in embedded software development and quality assurance in the automotive industry.
- Very good business English skills; German language skills are an advantage.

Would you like to improve the stability, reliability, and performance of next-generation automotive platforms in a highly collaborative environment? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

What we offer in Ulm?

- Company car option.
- English speaking teams in an intercultural setting.
- Flexible organisation of working times & mobile work arrangements.
- Career development & continuous personal qualification.
- Relocation Services for our new employees.

Earliest starting date: from now on

Working hours: full time
